summary: @lyxa.ai/core routes consumer event bus to hardcoded author CloudAMQP broker and ships Firebase Admin private keys as defaults
details: The package's bootstrapCore entrypoint unconditionally initializes the event bus against a hardcoded CloudAMQP AMQP URL with embedded credentials (amqps://adlvedna:<redacted>@dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna). Consumers calling the documented bootstrap function send their runtime event traffic to the author's message broker with no override path in the reachable code. In addition, configuration/index.js embeds four live Firebase Admin service-account RSA private keys and client emails (projects for-poc-325210, lyxa-rider-88939, lyxa-shop) as defaults in ConfigurationService._defaultOptions; when callers do not supply their own firebaseAdmin, FCMService and FirebaseService operations execute against the author's Firebase projects using these shipped credentials, routing FCM and Firestore traffic through the author's infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
